senses.gloss: to make available for use; to supply

definition_translations.ja_JP: 使用できるようにする；供給する
definition_translations.vi_VN: cung cấp để sử dụng; cung ứng
definition_translations.th_TH: จัดให้ใช้ได้; จัดหาให้

senses.gloss: to state as a condition or requirement in a legal document
senses.example: The contract provides that all payments must be made within thirty days.

example_translations.zh_TW: 合約規定所有款項必須在三十天內支付。
example_translations.ja_JP: 契約では、すべての支払いを30日以内に行わなければならないと定めています。
example_translations.ko_KR: 계약서에는 모든 대금이 30일 이내에 지급되어야 한다고 규정되어 있습니다.
example_translations.vi_VN: Hợp đồng quy định rằng tất cả các khoản thanh toán phải được thực hiện trong vòng ba mươi ngày.
example_translations.th_TH: สัญญากำหนดว่าการชำระเงินทั้งหมดต้องดำเนินการภายในสามสิบวัน
